referenceFunction.generalComment: Average data for the operation of Swiss trams. The data has been determined top down, by combining the total yearly energy consumption and the yearly vkm-performance. Particulate emissions due to abrasion of rail tracks, wheels, brakes and overhead contact line is included. For a first estimate of European trams, the user may change the electricity mix.; UUID: ad25793a-52eb-34d6-bb30-b350d18de185
